Google Tag Manager.notes: Consent on the source is Didomi, not GTM: the page HTML wraps the GTM snippet in `<script type="didomi/javascript" data-vendor="c:googleana-4TXnJigR" data-purposes="measure_ad_performance,improve_products">`, so GTM only executes after Didomi grants that vendor (read from https://omyapersonalcare.us/ server HTML, <head>). Didomi loads inline from sdk.privacy-center.org with public API key `140e89a8-992a-4e56-b3c6-7c311b7e0e6d`, notice `ACt2ytmx` (same HTML, `spcloader` snippet); footer link `javascript:Didomi.preferences.show()`. vendors.json has no `cmp` loader knowledge for Didomi, so `consent.cmp` stays null: the owner adds the Didomi loader (or extends vendors.json) and gates the GTM route on the Didomi vendor/purposes before enabling. No Google Consent Mode default inline (0/6 pages); the GTM library references ads_data_redaction only. Form rules depend on source ids (#contact-form, #onboarding-form, #credit-application), the jQuery ajaxComplete payload and `.form-message…success`: the rebuilt forms must push equivalent dataLayer events or the owner rewrites these triggers. UA tags (UA-116841070-1) are dead since UA sunset — owner may drop them. reCAPTCHA v2 is page-level (www.google.com/recaptcha), not a GTM tag.
